headline: TLS CA bundle extends the system trust store

items.title: Configured CA bundle no longer replaces the system trust store
items.body: A configured `caBundle` previously overrode Node's built-in CA list entirely, which broke outbound TLS to anything outside the configured CA (notably the GitHub-release downloader used by the auto-updater). The bundle now extends `tls.rootCertificates` rather than replacing it. Operators who explicitly want the override-only behavior can opt in via the new `caBundleMode: 'replace'` config key.
